entities.name: Virginia de Castro e Almeida
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Virginia de Castro e Almeida was a Portuguese writer. She is remembered for being a pioneer in Portuguese children's literature, translating important cultural texts, and as being a film director and founding her own film company, Fortuna Films.
